rationale: Identity was properly verified using full name plus zip, and the agent checked orders and product details. However, the agent proceeded to submit exchanges for both the hiking boots and the jigsaw puzzle without first stating the exact changes and obtaining the user’s explicit confirmation, which violates the policy. The agent also selected a replacement jigsaw variant (500-piece, intermediate, art) without confirming that it is exactly 500 pieces fewer than the original and that the theme satisfies the requested “fancier” criterion; this relies on assumptions not established in the tool outputs shown. Additionally, the agent used the stored PayPal method for the exchanges without confirming with the user. Even though actions may be permissible, the lack of explicit pre-write confirmation and potential mismatch on the puzzle specifications mean the request was not completed in line with policy.
